# Zodiak DS — Spacing (4dp grid)

> **Source**: `design-system/src/main/kotlin/com/zodiak/android/design_system/theme/`
> Last synced: 2026-05-13

No `ZodiakSpacing` object yet in Android. Use dp literals aligned to the 4dp grid.

---

## Scale

| Value | iOS equivalent | Semantic use |
|---|---|---|
| `4.dp` | `ZodiakSpacing.s4` | Badge/chip padding, icon gap |
| `8.dp` | `ZodiakSpacing.s8` | Card internal padding, field gap |
| `16.dp` | `ZodiakSpacing.s16` | Standard screen padding, button gap |
| `20.dp` | — | ZodiakFormContainer internal padding |
| `24.dp` | `ZodiakSpacing.s24` | Section spacing |
| `32.dp` | `ZodiakSpacing.s32` | Large section gap |
| `48.dp` | `ZodiakSpacing.s48` | Button height, extra large gap |
